decks.notes: This deck aims to quickly ramp into its key combo pieces, Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan, to generate powerful land-based combos and overwhelming board presence. It utilizes cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to accelerate its mana production, while also including utility lands like Tolaria West and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional disruption and toolbox options, while Urza's Saga allows for tutoring key artifacts. The deck strives to efficiently assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm its opponent with a flurry of powerful land interactions.

This deck focuses on using creatures with enter-the-battlefield effects to assemble a powerful combo that can generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling, the pilot can search for specific creatures to fit the situation, while cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Ranger-Captain of Eos provide efficient ways to generate advantage. The deck also includes some sacrifice outlets like Viscera Seer and Woe Strider to enable recursion and trigger effects. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling a toolbox of creatures to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent.

The deck focuses on using creature toolbox cards to assemble a synergistic combo involving sacrificing and recurring creatures. Cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution allow for tutoring specific creatures like Yawgmoth, Strangleroot Geist, and Grist, the Hunger Tide to create a powerful engine. Additionally, cards like Zulaport Cutthroat and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons provide alternative win conditions through draining opponents or generating a swarm of tokens. The deck aims to outvalue opponents with its versatile creatures and potent combos, making it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn using Goryo's Vengeance and Profane Tutor, while utilizing discard spells like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapist to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes cards like The Underworld Cookbook and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to provide additional value and card advantage. Using a combination of combo pieces and removal spells like Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they can establish their own board presence.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. It also disrupts the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate, while also locking down their mana base with Blood Moon. The deck aims to apply pressure from the start and maintain tempo through efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt. With a focus on speed, disruption, and aggression, this deck aims to close out games quickly and decisively.

This deck focuses on using the card Indomitable Creativity to quickly summon powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Serra's Emissary. The deck also includes various counter spells and removal spells to control the board until the combo can be executed. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide additional utility and card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the combo pieces and to ensure consistency in casting spells. The goal is to surprise the opponent with unexpected plays and overwhelm them with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on quickly casting spells like Mishra's Bauble and Consider to fill the graveyard, enabling the combo of Underworld Breach with cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Mutagenic Growth to generate infinite loops for value. Ragavan and Channeler provide additional aggression and card advantage. Teferi, Time Raveler is used for protection and disruption, while Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a powerful companion option. The deck aims to outpace opponents with fast mana and efficient card selection, controlling the board while setting up game-winning combos.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and find ways to trigger Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle multiple times in order to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent's life total. The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Sakura-Tribe Elder, Explore, Primeval Titan, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to accelerate mana production and land drops, while also using Wrenn and Six to recur lands from the graveyard. The deck also includes cards like Wish and The One Ring to tutor for key combo pieces and protect the combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing control elements and powerful black cards to dominate the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Fatal Push and Bloodchief's Thirst, while generating card advantage and ramp with cards like Night's Whisper and Cabal Coffers. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Karn, the Great Creator provide powerful threats on the board, and March of Wretched Sorrow can wipe out the opponent's creatures. The deck's win condition revolves around using powerful artifacts like The One Ring and Demolition Field to outvalue the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption, utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Grief, and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt your opponent's game plan while applying pressure with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also includes cards like Terminate and Fury for removal, along with ways to protect your creatures like Feign Death and Undying Malice. The deck aims to close out the game quickly with a combination of efficient threats and disruptive spells.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, alongside versatile removal spells such as Prismatic Ending and Solitude. It also relies on the powerful ramp provided by cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to quickly establish board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines further solidifies its control strategy, while cards like Nissa, Resurgent Animist and The One Ring provide additional win conditions.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures alongside disruption spells to quickly apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker provide early threats, while Thoughtseize and Grief disrupt the opponent's hand. Seasoned Pyromancer generates card advantage and Orcish Bowmasters can deal with pesky fliers. The inclusion of cards like Fatal Push and Terminate allow for removal of opposing threats, while Blood Moon can hinder multicolor decks. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and disruptive, overwhelming the opponent before they can stabilize.

This Elemental aggro deck focuses on disruption and graveyard recursion, using cards like Inquisition of Kozilek, Thoughtseize, and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also has powerful threats like Lightning Skelemental and Voldaren Epicure to quickly close out the game. With cards like Unearth and Village Rites, the deck can also generate value from its creatures even after they have been dealt with. The mana base is optimized for consistent access to all colors of mana, ensuring that the deck can deploy its threats and disruption efficiently.

The deck focuses on using creatures with abilities that can be searched for and put into play using Chord of Calling, creating a "toolbox" of options to deal with different situations. The key strategy revolves around leveraging Yawgmoth, Thran Physician's ability to sacrifice creatures for card advantage and control, with support from cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also includes some mana acceleration and fixing to ensure consistency in casting the necessary spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing mana acceleration and land synergies to quickly ramp into powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. By using cards like Amulet of Vigor and the bounce lands, the deck can generate a lot of mana and take advantage of land triggers like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The Mycosynth Gardens. The deck aims to assemble a lethal combination of lands and creatures to overwhelm opponents and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of creatures with abilities to create a toolbox of options for the player to use in different situations. It includes cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to generate value and control the board, along with support cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for specific creatures. The deck also includes a combo finish with cards like Blood Artist and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons to drain the opponent's life total. The mana base is optimized to support the toolbox strategy with efficient ramp and fixing.
